title: The shortest in-class practice set (6, 8 or 10 problems) that keeps Tamberlin County's seventh-grade spring 2027 failed checks within 4,100 reteach places, with 2025-26 practice by school and spring 2026 Math Lab hours
subdomain: learning-analytics-early-warning-models (each student's chance of falling short on a check taken after a fixed set of practice problems in one sitting, read from mastery-based homework logs)
prompt_shape: 04: the expected failed checks at each allowed set length, the shortest within the places, each spring unit at it, and two school-level asks (24 figures)
stated_inputs: the spring plan's routine, check, places, set lengths and roll date (spring_2027_grade7_math_plan.docx)
the platform's skill-builder rules and export layouts (pellmore_skill_builder_guide.pdf)
the Math Lab session record and hours rules (math_lab_procedures_2025-26.pdf)

sources.origin: generated by task174/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional county school district in North Carolina: seventh graders practising a math platform's skill builders as homework under a three-in-a-row completion rule and a ten-a-day limit, their enrollment spells, platform accounts and the spring 2026 Math Lab; layouts follow the kinds of public files named, every organisation, school, product and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced.
